goal: Validate one ESP32 sensor power change with independent evidence.

primary_metric.name: verified_acceptance_gates
primary_metric.threshold: all required proof stages have evidence

results: host check pass; hardware gate remains open

per_iteration_budget: one causal change and one verification pass
evaluation_method: independent host checks plus user-supplied physical evidence
acceptance_rule: keep only if all applicable gates pass and no protected file changes
rollback_method: restore the experiment surface and rerun the baseline check
plateau_rule: stop after two consecutive non-improving candidates
